# lago_organization (Resource)

Manages the Lago organization settings. This is a singleton resource — only one instance may exist per provider configuration. `Create` calls the organization update API (upsert); `Delete` is a no-op because the organization always exists in Lago.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lago_organization" "this" {
  name             = "Acme Corp"
  email            = "billing@acme.example.com"
  default_currency = "USD"
  timezone         = "America/New_York"

  legal_name                = "Acme Corporation Ltd."
  legal_number              = "123456789"
  tax_identification_number = "US123456789"

  address_line1 = "123 Main Street"
  address_line2 = "Suite 400"
  city          = "New York"
  state         = "NY"
  zipcode       = "10001"
  country       = "US"

  net_payment_term             = 30
  document_numbering           = "per_organization"
  document_number_prefix       = "ACME"
  finalize_zero_amount_invoice = true

  email_settings = [
    "invoice.finalized",
    "credit_note.created",
  ]

  billing_configuration {
    invoice_grace_period = 3
    invoice_footer       = "Thank you for your business."
    document_locale      = "en"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address_line1` (String) First line of the organization's billing address.
- `address_line2` (String) Second line of the organization's billing address.
- `billing_configuration` (Attributes) Organization-level billing configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing_configuration))
- `city` (String) City of the organization's billing address.
- `country` (String) Country of the organization's billing address (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `US`).
- `default_currency` (String) Default currency for the organization (ISO 4217, e.g. `USD`).
- `document_number_prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to all generated document numbers.
- `document_numbering` (String) Invoice document numbering scheme. Allowed values: `per_customer`, `per_organization`.
- `email` (String) Organization contact email address.
- `email_settings` (Set of String) Set of event types that trigger email notifications (e.g. `invoice.finalized`, `credit_note.created`).
- `finalize_zero_amount_invoice` (Boolean) When `true`, invoices with a zero total amount are finalized rather than voided. Note: the underlying API field uses `omitempty`, so setting this to `false` after it has been enabled may require manual adjustment in the Lago UI.
- `legal_name` (String) Legal name of the organization.
- `legal_number` (String) Legal registration number of the organization.
- `name` (String) Organization display name.
- `net_payment_term` (Number) Default net payment term in days applied to invoices.
- `state` (String) State or region of the organization's billing address.
- `tax_identification_number` (String) Tax identification number (VAT number) of the organization.
- `timezone` (String) Default timezone for the organization (TZ database name, e.g. `Europe/Paris`).
- `zipcode` (String) Postal code of the organization's billing address.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Organization creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID. Always set to `"organization"`.

<a id="nestedatt--billing_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `billing_configuration`

Optional:

- `document_locale` (String) Locale used when generating invoice documents (e.g. `en`, `fr`, `de`).
- `invoice_footer` (String) Footer text that appears on all generated invoices.
- `invoice_grace_period` (Number) Grace period in days before an invoice is finalized after its billing period ends.
